async function loadPage(first) { const root = document.getElementById('latest-reviews'); const spinner = document.getElementById('page-spinner'); const loadMore = document.getElementById('page-load-more'); spinner.classList.remove('d-none'); loadMore.classList.add('d-none'); const lastCursor = root.dataset.lastCursor; const query = document.getElementById('reviewsGQL').textContent; const firstPage = await fetch( "/api/graphql", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json", }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: query, variables: { first: first, after: lastCursor} }) } ) const template = document.getElementById('review-template').innerHTML; const data = (await firstPage.json()).data const edges = data.reviews.edges for (const edge of edges) { let element = document.createElement('div'); element.innerHTML = nunjucks.renderString(template, {review: edge.node}); root.appendChild(element.firstElementChild); root.dataset.lastCursor = edge.cursor; }
